notes: The manual covers many separate circuits (LED, button, buzzer, traffic lights, PIR, ultrasonic sensor, MCP3008 pot, motors) but only the LDR light-sensing circuit has the provided images, so only that circuit is built.
Pi in the Fritzing image is rotated 180 degrees. From the pin positions: red wire = pin 1 (3V3.1), green wire = pin 7 (GPIO4, matches LightSensor(4) in the code), black wire = pin 6 (GND.1).
Breadboard columns are numbered from the right in the Fritzing image. Red lead in column 1, green in column 3, black in column 5, all in row a (top bank).

The LDR spans columns 1 and 3 (row e). The capacitor's long positive leg is in column 3, the same strip as the LDR and GPIO4 lead, and its negative leg is in column 5 with the GND lead, as the text says. Capacitor rows (d) are assumed.
The 1 uF polarised capacitor is modelled with the catalogue capacitor-10uf type, with value=1uF set as a prop.
Jumper leads are modelled as male-to-female: female end (a) on the Pi header pin, male end (b) in the breadboard.
